struct.name: recovery_time
struct.note: How long the shout takes to recharge. For the player's dragon shouts it is the total recharge time, and for the others it is usually a small arbitrary number.

struct.name: rotate_while_moving_run
struct.note: Only present when the INAM is.

struct.name: layers
struct.note: One byte per layer. The float is encoded as a uint8, where 0x00 is -0.1, 0x7f is 0 and 0xfe is 0.1.

SHOU.name: Shout
SHOU.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/SHOU. A shout is three words, each with a spell and a recovery time. [measured: 225 SNAM fields in Skyrim.esm, each 12 bytes]

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

MDOB.name: Inventory Model
MDOB.note: The model (STAT) shown in the inventory.

DESC.name: Description
DESC.note: The shout's description, or zero if it has none.

SNAM.name: Shout Data
SNAM.note: One of the shout's three words: the word of power, the spell it casts and the recovery time.

MOVT.name: Movement
MOVT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MOVT. [measured: SPED is 44 bytes in 77 of Skyrim.esm's MOVT records and 40 in the rest, the difference being the rotate-while-moving run that only appears when the INAM does]

MNAM.name: Name
MNAM.note: The simplified name, usually the editor id without the trailing _MT.

SPED.name: Default Data
SPED.note: The movement's speeds: the walk and run of each direction, and the rotation in place and while moving.

INAM.name: Anim Change Thresholds
INAM.note: The directional, movement speed and rotation speed scales. Each is 57.296.

FSTP.name: Footstep
FSTP.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FSTP. [measured: 116 FSTP records in Skyrim.esm]

ANAM.name: Action Name
ANAM.note: The action's name, for example FootLeft or FootScuffRight. It does not correspond with an AACT.

SOPM.name: Sound Output Model
SOPM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/SOPM. [measured: 69 SOPM records in Skyrim.esm]

COLL.name: Collision
COLL.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/COLL. [measured: 55 COLL records in Skyrim.esm; CNAM is a run of layer names]

CNAM.name: Collision Layers
CNAM.note: The names of the collision's layers. There is no count of its own, so it is a run of names.

WTHR.name: Weather
WTHR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/WTHR. The cloud textures have a signature per layer: 00TX is layer 0, and layer n uses a texture whose signature is the character 0 plus n followed by 0TX. [measured: 1,537 WTHR records in Skyrim.esm; the cloud texture colour is 512 bytes and the alpha 512 bytes]

LNAM.name: Texture Layer Count
LNAM.note: How many texture layers the clouds have. It is always 0x04 or 0x1d.

RNAM.name: Cloud Speed Y
RNAM.note: 32 bytes, one per layer. The byte for layer n is a float encoded as a uint8, where 0x00 is -0.1, 0x7f is 0 and 0xfe is 0.1.

QNAM.name: Cloud Speed X
QNAM.note: 32 bytes, one per layer, encoded as the cloud speed Y is.

PNAM.name: Cloud Texture Colour
PNAM.note: 512 bytes: 32 structs of 16 bytes, one per layer, each with the sunrise, day, sunset and night colours.

JNAM.name: Cloud Texture Alpha
JNAM.note: 512 bytes: 32 structs of 16 bytes, one per layer, each with the sunrise, day, sunset and night alphas.

NAM0.name: Colours
NAM0.note: 208, 224 or 272 bytes of 16-byte structs, each with the sunrise, day, sunset and night colours. The n-th struct is the sky upper, fog near, a layer that seems to be ignored, ambient, sunlight, sun, stars, sky lower, horizon, effect lightning, cloud LOD diffuse, cloud LOD ambient, fog far, and others.
